items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. I knew Snub. He was in the last band I played with, up in New York.

ctx.x: And they waited for those guys after the gig, and they castrated a lot of them. That's what he told me.
Yeah. I knew Snub. He was in the last band I played with, up in New York. Cab was down there in St. Petersburg, and we had a drummer down there with us in Don Redman's band that had got hit.
